meta.name: swiss-legal-drafting
meta.description: Swiss legal document drafter — creates contracts (OR), court submissions (ZPO), and legal opinions (Gutachten) in DE/FR/IT/EN with correct Swiss citations and Gutachtenstil. Trigger when: a user asks to draft, write, or create a legal document. Uses swiss-citation-formats for citation verification and swiss-legal-research for jurisdiction resolution. Do NOT trigger for: document analysis (swiss-document-analysis), research (swiss-legal-research), or citation formatting only.
